1	# WP-001: Knowledge View UX Fixes
     2	
     3	## Plan Context
     4	
     5	This rework addresses all actionable items from the synthesis report for plan `2026-05-28-knowledge-gui-rework`, fixing UX degradation (search-input focus loss, duplicated `getDistinctValues` logic), a TOCTOU race condition, incomplete search forwarding, CSP `unsafe-inline`, and maintainability debt.
     6	
     7	## Description
     8	
     9	Fix the search-input focus-loss UX regression in the Knowledge page and extract the duplicated distinct-value collection logic into a shared helper function.
    10	
    11	## Scope
    12	
    13	- `mcp-server/gui/public/views/knowledge.js` — the Knowledge SPA view (plain ES5)
    14	
    15	## Deliverables
    16	
    17	- Focus-preservation guard in `renderList()` that captures `document.activeElement` before filter-bar DOM rebuild and conditionally restores focus to `#kn-query` afterward
    18	- `getDistinctValues(insights)` private helper function inside `renderKnowledge()` that returns `{ categories, projects }` sorted arrays, replacing inline collection loops in both `render()` and `wireFilterBarEvents()`
    19	
    20	## Dependencies
    21	
    22	- None
    23	
    24	## Acceptance Criteria
    25	
    26	1. Typing in the Knowledge page search input does not cause the input to lose focus between keystrokes.
    27	2. `getDistinctValues()` is a single private helper inside `renderKnowledge()`; no inline category/project collection loops remain in `render()` or `wireFilterBarEvents()`.
    28	3. The focus guard is conditional (`hadFocus` check) — it must NOT unconditionally call `.focus()`, because `renderList()` is triggered by card actions (edit, cancel, delete, move) where stealing focus would be a UX regression.
    29	4. All existing tests pass with zero regressions.
    30	
    31	## Active Pipeline Stages
    32	
    33	`implementation` → `qa` → `code-review` → `documentation`
    34	
    35	## Estimated Complexity
    36	
    37	Low
    38	
    39	## Rationale
    40	
    41	The focus-loss issue is a confirmed UX regression on the primary interactive control of the Knowledge page. The `getDistinctValues` duplication was flagged as a drift risk. Both fixes are cosmetic/structural with no API surface change.
    42	
    43	## Notes
    44	
    45	This WP is independent and can run in parallel with WP-002. The `views/knowledge.js` changes are verified by manual browser testing; `getDistinctValues` is a pure refactor with no observable output difference testable at the unit level. All `gui/public/` JS files use plain ES5 (no `const`, `let`, arrow functions, template literals).
